story: Ben wanted to eat the bread, but a puppy shivered on a high ledge. Ben said, “The puppy needs help.” Mum said, “I can lower the basket.” Ben said, “I can share the bread.” Ben put the bread in the basket. Mum carried the basket to the window, and she lowered the basket to the ledge with the rope. Ben waited because the puppy was frightened. The puppy entered the basket, and it ate the bread. Mum lowered the basket to the garden with the rope. Ben carried the puppy into the cottage, and he wrapped the puppy in the warm blanket. Ben was hungry, but the puppy rested in the warm blanket.

story: Nia wanted to water the sunflower, but the tomato seedlings were thirsty. Mr Bell said, “The tap is broken.” The rain barrel held one can of water. Nia filled the watering can from the rain barrel. Nia said, “I can divide water equally.” She divided water equally between the tomato seedlings and the sunflower. The shade cloth fell. Nia secured the umbrella above the tomato seedlings with the garden tie. She moved the sunflower under the umbrella. Mr Bell said, “I promise to repair the tap tomorrow.” The tomato seedlings and the sunflower stood under the umbrella.

Nia said, “I can divide water equally.”
She divided water equally between the tomato seedlings and the sunflower.
The shade cloth fell.
Nia secured the umbrella above the tomato seedlings with the garden tie.
Nia moved the sunflower under the umbrella.
Mr Bell said, “I promise to repair the tap tomorrow.”
The tomato seedlings and the sunflower stood under the umbrella.

The tomato seedlings had a brown leaf. Nia secured the umbrella above the tomato seedlings with the garden tie. Mr Bell repaired the tap. Nia watered the tomato seedlings with water from the tap. Mrs Okafor repaired the shade cloth with the clip. The tomato seedlings stood under the repaired shade cloth, but the tomato seedlings had a brown leaf.
